name: Three-lane endless runner
summary: Run forward forever down three lanes; swipe to switch lanes, jump and slide past obstacles, and grab coins.
core_loop: swipe left or right to change lanes → swipe up to jump, down to slide → grab coins → speed rises → crash ends the run
rules: hitting a barrier ends the run
social_hooks: beat a friend's distance on the same seed
example_prompts: like temple run but in space
endless runner where you dodge trains

name: One-tap jump runner
summary: The character runs automatically on one line; tap to jump over gaps and obstacles.
core_loop: run automatically → tap to jump → clear obstacles → go as far as you can
social_hooks: ghost race against friends on the daily seed
example_prompts: chrome dino game but with my dog

name: Beat-synced runner
summary: Obstacles are placed on the beat of the music; jump, slide and kick in rhythm to clear the level.
core_loop: the run follows the song → act on the beat → reach the end of the track
rules: one hit restarts from a checkpoint
win: reach the end of the song
example_prompts: geometry dash with a taylor swift song
runner where you jump to the beat

name: Gravity flip runner
summary: Tap to flip gravity and run along the ceiling or floor to avoid gaps and spikes.
core_loop: run automatically → tap to flip between floor and ceiling → avoid gaps → keep going

name: Hold-to-fly runner
summary: Hold to fly up and release to fall while the run auto-scrolls past lasers and missiles.
core_loop: The run scrolls on its own; hold to fire the jetpack and rise, release to fall, and thread gaps between lasers and missiles while grabbing coins
social_hooks: weekly distance board in a Group

name: Tap-to-flap flyer
summary: Tap to flap upward through gaps in pipes; gravity pulls you down between taps.
core_loop: Gravity pulls you down; tap to flap upward through each gap between pipes, scoring a point per gap, until you hit one
rules: each tap gives a fixed upward push
lose: hitting a pipe or the ground
example_prompts: flappy bird but it's my professor

name: Endless crossing hopper
summary: Hop forward across endless lanes of traffic, rivers and trains; stand still too long and you're caught.
core_loop: tap to hop forward → swipe to sidestep → time gaps in traffic → keep moving
rules: waiting too long ends the run
lose: hit by traffic, drowning or waiting too long
example_prompts: crossy road but in new york
cross the road with a duck

name: Downhill slalom
summary: Ski or board downhill automatically; tilt or tap to steer through gates and around trees.
core_loop: steer left and right → pass through gates → avoid trees → go faster
rules: hitting a tree ends the run
example_prompts: ski down a mountain dodging trees

name: Wall-jump climber
summary: Bounce between two walls going upward; tap to jump to the other wall, avoiding spikes.
core_loop: Cling to one of two walls; tap to leap to the other side, dodging spikes, and climb as high as you can
rules: each tap jumps to the opposite wall

name: Endless upward jumper
summary: Bounce up on platforms forever; tilt or tap to move sideways and land on the next platform.
core_loop: bounce automatically → move sideways → land on platforms → climb
rules: landing on a platform bounces you up
falling below the screen ends the run

name: Growing snake runner
summary: Steer a snake that grows as it eats; don't hit walls or yourself.
core_loop: Steer a snake around the arena; each food makes it longer, and the run ends if it hits a wall or its own tail
rules: hitting yourself or a wall ends it

name: Spinning tunnel runner
summary: Fly down a tunnel and rotate around its walls to dodge gaps and blockers.
core_loop: rotate around the tunnel → line up with the open path → keep flying
social_hooks: daily tunnel shared in a Group

name: Boost pad sprint
summary: Run a fixed course hitting boost pads and avoiding slowdowns to set the fastest time.
core_loop: run → hit boost pads → avoid mud and spikes → reach the finish fast
social_hooks: ghost race your friend's best time
example_prompts: run fast and hit boost pads

name: Zigzag path
summary: A ball runs along a narrow zigzag path; tap to switch direction at each corner.
core_loop: tap to turn at each corner → stay on the path → collect gems
rules: leaving the path ends the run

name: Color gate runner
summary: Move through obstacles that rotate; you can only pass through parts that match your color.
core_loop: tap to move up → time your pass through your color → color changes at switches
rules: you can only cross your own color

name: Shape-shift runner
summary: Walls with cutouts approach; switch your shape to fit through each hole.
core_loop: see the wall → pick the matching shape → pass through → speed rises
example_prompts: change shape to fit through walls

name: Gap jumping with charge
summary: Hold to charge a jump or a bridge the right length to reach the next platform.
core_loop: hold to charge → release → land on the next platform → repeat
rules: too short or too long and you fall
example_prompts: hold to jump the right distance

name: Grapple swing
summary: Tap to grapple an anchor and swing forward; release at the right moment to fly.
core_loop: Tap to grab the next anchor, swing forward on the rope, and release at the top of the arc to fly to the one after
rules: falling to the ground ends the run

name: Rider with lasso
summary: Ride animals at a gallop; leap to a new animal before your current one bucks you off.
core_loop: ride → avoid obstacles → leap to another animal → tame new animals
rules: each animal stays tame for limited time

name: Rooftop parkour
summary: Run across rooftops and swipe to vault, slide and wall-run past a chaser.
core_loop: Run across rooftops with a chaser behind you; swipe to vault, slide and wall-run past obstacles to stay ahead
rules: the chaser catches you if you slow down

name: Mine cart track switcher
summary: Ride a cart on rails; tap to jump gaps and switch tracks at junctions.
core_loop: ride → switch tracks at forks → jump broken rails → collect gems
rules: only one track at a time
example_prompts: switch tracks on a roller coaster

name: Escape the chaser
summary: A chaser follows; stumbles bring it closer and two stumbles end the run.
core_loop: Run ahead of a chaser; each stumble on an obstacle brings it closer, and a second stumble before recovering ends the run
rules: each stumble lets the chaser gain
two stumbles in a row end the run

name: Dash runner
summary: Tap to dash forward with brief invulnerability; time dashes through hazards.
core_loop: run → tap to dash → pass through hazards while invulnerable → recharge
lose: hitting a hazard outside a dash

name: Swim runner
summary: Swim forward through currents; tap to rise, release to sink, eat small fish, avoid big ones.
core_loop: Swim forward through currents; tap to rise and release to sink, eat smaller fish to grow, and avoid bigger ones

name: Glider
summary: Glide forward; tap to catch updrafts and keep altitude, avoiding obstacles.
core_loop: Your plane glides and slowly loses height; tap to catch updrafts and keep altitude while weaving past obstacles
rules: touching the ground ends the flight

name: Traffic dodger
summary: Drive down a highway, swiping between lanes to pass slower cars.
core_loop: swipe lanes → pass cars → speed rises → near misses score more

name: Rolling ball path
summary: Roll a ball down a winding course; drag to steer and avoid falling off edges.
core_loop: drag to steer → stay on the path → avoid holes → reach the end
rules: falling off the edge ends it
example_prompts: roll a ball down the course

name: Keep your altitude
summary: Hold to rise and release to fall through a cave that narrows.
core_loop: Hold to rise and release to fall as you fly through a cave whose ceiling and floor slowly close in

name: Collect the trail
summary: Follow a trail of collectibles; staying on the trail builds a multiplier.
core_loop: Follow a winding trail of collectibles; grabbing them in a row builds a multiplier that resets if you leave the trail or hit a hazard
rules: missing a collectible resets the multiplier

name: Stairs turn runner
summary: Climb stairs that turn left or right; tap the correct direction before the step crumbles.
core_loop: Each next step turns left or right; tap the correct direction before the step crumbles, climbing faster as you go

name: Two-runner split control
summary: Control two runners at once, one with each thumb, each in its own lanes.
core_loop: left thumb steers one → right thumb steers the other → both survive
rules: each side has its own lanes

name: Mirror-control runner
summary: Controls periodically flip; adapt to inverted steering while running.
core_loop: Run and steer around obstacles; every so often the controls flip, and you adapt to inverted steering mid-run
rules: flips are announced one second ahead

name: Size-change runner
summary: Tap to shrink under gaps or hold to grow to break barriers.
core_loop: Read each obstacle ahead; tap to shrink under low gaps or hold to grow and smash through barriers
rules: small fits low gaps; big breaks thin walls

name: Crowd gate runner
summary: Steer a crowd through math gates (x2, +10, -5) to grow it before a final battle.
core_loop: Steer a crowd through pairs of math gates such as x2 or minus 5, pick the better gate each time, and face a boss crowd at the end
rules: the bigger crowd wins the battle

name: Stack-carrying runner
summary: Collect blocks on your head while running; obstacles knock some off; spend the stack at the end.
core_loop: Collect blocks onto a stack as you run; obstacles knock some off, and you spend the stack at the finish for points
rules: the stack multiplies at the end

name: Paint the path
summary: Run and leave a color trail; cover the most of the floor before time ends.
core_loop: Run around an arena leaving a color trail on the floor; cover more of the floor than rivals before time ends
rules: rivals can paint over your tiles

name: Collect and bridge
summary: Collect planks while running and spend them to build bridges across gaps.
core_loop: Collect planks as you run, then spend them to build bridges across gaps; run short and you fall

name: Obstacle course time trial
summary: Run a fixed obstacle course against the clock with swinging and moving hazards.
core_loop: run → jump and dodge hazards → reach checkpoints → beat the time
rules: hazards knock you back to the last checkpoint
social_hooks: race friends' ghosts on the same course

name: Dash for treasure
summary: Run a short course grabbing treasures; the more you carry, the slower you go.
core_loop: Grab treasures on a short course; every item slows you down, so choose when to bank before the clock runs out

name: Bouncing ball runner
summary: A ball bounces automatically; tap to bounce higher or lower to clear obstacles.
core_loop: ball bounces → adjust the bounce → clear gaps and spikes → go far

name: Run and gun
summary: Run automatically while tapping to shoot obstacles and enemies ahead.
core_loop: Run automatically to the right and tap to shoot obstacles and enemies ahead, collecting power-ups as you go

name: Run in the dark
summary: Run in darkness with a light that shrinks; collect lights to see further.
core_loop: Run in the dark with a light that slowly shrinks; collect lights to see further and spot obstacles in time
rules: your light radius shrinks over time
example_prompts: runner in the dark with a lantern

name: Shifting weather runner
summary: Wind, rain and ice change how you move as the run goes on.
core_loop: Run a long course where wind, rain and ice keep changing how you move, and adjust your timing to keep going
rules: ice slides, wind pushes, rain slows

name: Relay runner
summary: Each lap a different teammate's runner takes over, each with a different move set.
core_loop: Each leg is run by a different teammate's runner with its own move, and you hand off to finish the relay fastest
social_hooks: Group relay where each friend runs a leg
example_prompts: team runner each person runs a leg

name: Magnet collector
summary: Toggle a magnet that pulls coins but also pulls hazards.
core_loop: Toggle a magnet that pulls nearby coins but also hazards; switch it on near coins and off near danger

name: Auto-scroll platformer
summary: Run automatically across platforms; tap to jump, hold for higher, and vault enemies.
core_loop: Run automatically across platforms; tap to jump, hold for a higher jump, and vault enemies to reach the flag
example_prompts: mario but it runs by itself

name: Race your friend's ghost
summary: Run the same course as a friend's recorded ghost and try to beat it.
core_loop: Run the same course as a friend's recorded ghost and try to beat their time to the finish
rules: same seed as the friend's run
social_hooks: made for sending to a specific friend
